title: 군표창규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:27619:20161129:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Reserve Forces Act) <No. 27619, November 29, 2016>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Article 2 Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (6) Omitted.

(7) Part of the Regulations on Military Commendations shall be amended as follows:

In Article 3, "members of the homeland reserve forces" shall be replaced with "members of reserve forces" in each case.

(8) through (17) Omitted.

Article 4 Omitted.
